title: Aspen Search client list
description: A giant word beside a halftone window, then a hairline grid: label with a running mono counter, a paragraph and mono button, a colour panel per client, and a list of firms in large tight type with mono sector tags. As the list scrolls up the window the active row fills with ink from the bottom (0.8s, expo out) while the colour panel slides to that client and the counter follows; hovering a row makes it active.
notes: needs JavaScript: the active row follows the scroll (motion useScroll) and the pointer
colour panels use chart-1…5; each client's logo slot is empty (its name in mono) until given
the panel, counter and label are desktop only; phones show the window, word, copy and list
